connector.name: Profitlee MCP
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for the Profitlee ecommerce profit calculator (Amazon FBA/FBM + TikTok Shop).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package profitlee-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the aronleedev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PROFITLEE_API_TOKEN
env.description: Profitlee Pro API token (eck_live_...). Required only for the scenario tools; calculate_profit works without it.

env.name: PROFITLEE_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the Profitlee API origin (default https://profitlee.com). For testing.
